steps.en: Update and sending run as soon as the officer confirms
steps.id: Update dan pengiriman jalan langsung saat petugas konfirmasi
steps.why_en: The story wants these scheduled for later; the system does everything at once and has no schedule option.
steps.why_id: Story minta dijadwalkan; sistem langsung menjalankan semuanya dan tidak punya pilihan jadwal.

steps.en: Screen tells the officer the particulars update succeeded
steps.id: Layar memberi tahu petugas bahwa update particulars berhasil

steps.en: Screen tells the officer whether the email or SMS went out
steps.id: Layar memberi tahu petugas apakah email atau SMS terkirim
steps.why_en: A failure message appears but without the reason or which recipient failed, and nothing is scheduled.
steps.why_id: Pesan gagal muncul tanpa alasan atau penerima yang gagal, dan tidak ada yang dijadwalkan.

steps.en: Screen shows an error if the update fails and nothing is sent
steps.id: Layar menampilkan error jika update gagal dan tidak ada yang dikirim
